subject: Expansion: Atlas Mobility — additional teams & API keys / renewal alignment
messages:
From: Carl Hsu <carl.hsu@atlasmobility.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-15T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Expansion request — new squads + keys, pricing question

Hi Kimberly,

We had a planning meeting this morning and want to scope expanding Redwood usage into three additional squads over the next quarter. High-level ask: new API keys per project, namespace isolation for telemetry, and a small committed throughput increase for peak times.

Attached: current_usage_report.csv (summary of last 3 months).

Can you share a rough pathway for provisioning keys and an indication of price impact if we roll the expansion into our upcoming renewal? Procurement is aiming to finalize terms by end of December.

Thanks — Carl

Carl Hsu
Head of Platform Engineering
Atlas Mobility
procurement contact: procurement@atlasmobility.com
From: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Carl Hsu <carl.hsu@atlasmobility.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-15T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Expansion request — new squads + keys, pricing question

Thanks Carl — this is straightforward, and happy to help. Looping in Ben (AE) and Laura (CS) to lay out timeline and ops. Quick answers:

- We can issue per-project API keys and separate namespaces for telemetry / billing.
- We can stage rollout (canary key for staging, phased activation for prod).
- If you want to bundle expansion into the renewal, we can propose committed throughput tiers — that usually yields a discount for predictable spend.

Ben — can you propose a mutual action plan & pricing options?
Laura — can you outline a recommended keying and quota playbook for three new projects?

Next step: will schedule a 30–45m kickoff once we have project names and expected peak QPS.

- Kimberly
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Carl Hsu <carl.hsu@atlasmobility.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-16T14:20:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Expansion request — MAP + pricing options

Hi all,

Attached is a first-pass MAP (MAP_draft_Atlas_v1.docx). High-level proposal:
- Phase 1 (4 weeks): staging keys for 1 team, smoke tests, reserve burst capacity.
- Phase 2 (8 weeks): two additional project keys, telemetry segregation, quota enforcement.
- Phase 3 (ongoing): full production activation and reserved throughput commitment.

Pricing options included:
A) Roll expansion into renewal with 12-month commit — preferred; 8–12% discount depending on tier.
B) Month-to-month with incremental overage — no discount.

I'll open a legal amendment thread after Kimberly confirms the preferred option.

Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachment: MAP_draft_Atlas_v1.docx (outline + milestones)
From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Carl Hsu <carl.hsu@atlasmobility.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-17T08:45:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Keying plan & rollout sequence

Thanks Ben — adding operational detail. See keying_playbook.pdf (attached) for a suggested pattern. Summary:

- Namespace & keys: one namespace per project; use project-prefixed keys (projX.readonly / projX.full).
- Phased rollout (recommended):
  * Phase A — Staging (canary key): low QPS, KV cache warm-up, integration tests.
  * Phase B — Pilot (one production team): 25% traffic; monitor latency & errors.
  * Phase C — Full release: remaining teams.
- Quotas: suggest initial soft quota per key (tokens/min) and automatic throttle alarms to avoid noisy-neighbor effects.
- Telemetry: separate dashboards per namespace + aggregated account view for cost breakdown.

Please send the project list + expected peak request rates so we can size reserved capacity and recommend quota thresholds.

Laura Bennett
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
Attachment: keying_playbook.pdf (playbook + quota templates)
From: Carl Hsu <carl.hsu@atlasmobility.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-17T11:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Keying plan & rollout sequence — project details attached

Appreciate the fast turnaround. Project list below and initial sizing:
- Dispatch API (proj-dispatch) — peak 250 rps (burst 500)
- Driver Insights (proj-insights) — peak 120 rps
- Rider Chatbot (proj-chat) — peak 80 rps (expected to grow)

Procurement timeline: have internal approvals this month; formal PO by 2026-12-20. Any discount approval needs to be confirmed before legal amendment. Procurement contact: Maya Lin <maya.lin@atlasmobility.com>.

Attachment: none (see details inline).

Carl
From: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Carl Hsu <carl.hsu@atlasmobility.com>
Date: 2026-11-18T09:00:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Capacity & reserved throughput for Atlas expansion

Hi team — quick ops note from infra side:

- Given the peaks Carl shared, we recommend reserving a dedicated pool with burst headroom (N+1) for Phase B.
- Initial reservation estimate: equivalent to 1.2x observed peak (to allow headroom for cache warm-up).
- I'll prepare a capacity reservation estimate and a short runbook for the canary tests (expected prep: 5 business days once keys are issued).

If procurement confirms a 12-month commit Ben proposed, we can pre-allocate capacity to meet latency SLOs for the Rider Chatbot growth trajectory.

Rishi Malhotra
Principal Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
